summary: Iter23 backend tests: 11/11 passed. Verified all shop-flow fixes: (a) /api/seller/analytics — seeded one delivered split with seller_earning_usd=6.84 on a fresh seller, totals.today.revenue == 6.84 (not gross 10.0) and orders=1, all_time also 6.84 — confirms the aggregator sums seller_earning_usd from delivered splits + restaurant_orders. (b) /api/orders/mine returns order-level exchange_rate_ssp=6500 (seller's rate, from db.exchange_rates) alongside per-item rates. (c) create_marketplace_splits writes resolved delivery_managed_by='seller' onto the split (verified by direct Mongo mirror of the write pattern). (d) POST /api/seller/splits/{id}/self-deliver-start with body {driver_name, driver_phone} persists seller_driver_name + seller_driver_phone and moves the split to seller_preparation_status=handed_to_driver + delivery_status=out_for_delivery + self_delivered_by_seller=True; empty-body variant also 200. (e) POST /api/seller/splits/{id}/self-deliver-complete moves delivery_status=delivered + payment_status=collected_by_seller + cash_handover_status=not_applicable + delivered_at set. (f) Restaurant twin POST /api/seller/restaurant-orders/{id}/self-deliver-start persists seller_driver_name/phone. (g) GET /api/restaurant-orders/restaurant/{id} returns order.exchange_rate_ssp=6500 + per-item rate (enrich_restaurant_orders). (h) Regression: /api/odoo/health 200, admin login returns token, /api/admin/odoo/orders/pending 200. Frontend: home page loads clean (title, hero, categories rendered), no JS pageerrors, only expected anonymous 401 for /auth/me. All frontend claims verified by code review (grep): formatPrice paren bug gone (all call sites use formatPrice(value, detail.exchange_rate_ssp||exchangeRate, currency)), Completed sub-tab present between Active/Cancelled (line 225), Active filter excludes delivery_status==='delivered' (line 188), sellerIsDriver derived from delivery_managed_by==='seller' — Driver Pickup OTP block gated on !sellerIsDriver (line 635), buttons wallet-self-deliver-start (line 663) and wallet-self-deliver-complete (line 670) render when sellerIsDriver && ready_for_pickup. OrderStatusTimeline exports preparationStatus prop. Orders.jsx uses o.exchange_rate_ssp for delivery fee (both marketplace and restaurant sections) and computes driverContact from splits' seller_driver_phone || driver_phone with 'Driver ·' prefix.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py enrich_marketplace_orders picks the 'primary' rate as the FIRST item's seller rate. For multi-seller orders this is arbitrary — the customer's displayed delivery-fee SSP could disagree with what a downstream split records. Consider using the seller who owns the delivery fee split (or documenting that multi-seller orders share the primary seller's rate).

backend/cod.py seller_self_deliver_start and rest_self_deliver_start silently ignore body if driver_name/phone are empty strings (`if driver_name:` treats '' as falsy) — intentional for 'no update', but pydantic-model validation would surface obviously bad phones. Consider a lightweight Body model with regex-validated phone.

backend/server.py /api/seller/analytics: item_revenue_usd + per-product breakdown still uses db.orders (gross), while totals use seller_order_splits — semantically fine, but keep this discrepancy documented in the endpoint docstring so a future refactor doesn't unify them incorrectly.

frontend SellerWalletTab.jsx line 517: the condition `detail._kind === 'rest' ? (delivery_managed_by==='seller' || self_delivered_by_seller) : (same)` is identical in both branches — the ternary is redundant and can collapse to a single expression.

frontend Orders.jsx line 657: driverContactSplit picks the FIRST split with a driver_phone — for multi-shop customer orders where sellers self-deliver from different couriers, only one is shown. Consider grouping driver contacts per-shop in the UI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_shop_flow.py. IMPORTANT: requests.Session's cookies are DISABLED (BlockingJar) because /auth/login sets an access_token cookie that overrides the Bearer header on subsequent calls in a shared session and yields 403 'Insufficient permissions' for cross-role tests — always disable session cookies or use a fresh Session per identity. Admin creation of role=customer via /api/admin/users returns 200 for sellers but was avoided for customers (used /api/auth/signup + Mongo email_verified flip). Email domains ending in .local are rejected by pydantic EmailStr — use example.com. Analytics test uses a dedicated fresh seller because other tests in the module leave one delivered split behind that would otherwise double the today.revenue.
